PostToolUse.command: file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; ext="${file##*.}"; if [ "$ext" = "ts" ] || [ "$ext" = "tsx" ] || [ "$ext" = "js" ] || [ "$ext" = "mjs" ]; then npx eslint --fix "$file" 2>&1 | tail -5; fi

Stop.command: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test

PreToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_CONTENT" | grep -qiE '(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|password\s*=\s*["'\'']{1}[^"'\'']+["'\'']{1}|service_role|secret_key\s*=)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: possible secret detected in file content' && exit 1; fi
